description: Detailed pool metrics for a single Bittensor subnet by netuid: alpha price in TAO, TAO in pool, total alpha, alpha in pool, staked alpha, market cap, and liquidity. Requires TAOSTATS_API_KEY. Returns 404 for unknown netuid. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_tao_subnet_concentration when you need Stake and emission concentration analysis for a Bittensor; crypto_tao_subnet_metagraph when you need Full Bittensor subnet metagraph slice with pagination: uid. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_tao_subnet
title: Detailed pool metrics for a single Bittensor subnet
